items.title: Final Fantasy XIV Launches August 4 for Switch 2, Evercold Expansion in January 2027
items.summary: Square Enix announced Final Fantasy XIV will launch for the Nintendo Switch 2 on August 4 and the Evercold expansion [...]
items.content:
Square Enix announced Final Fantasy XIV will launch for the Nintendo Switch 2 on August 4 and the Evercold expansion will launch in January 2027.

Pre-orders for the Switch 2 versions are now open. It will require a separate monthly subscription from the other version, however, it will not require a Nintendo Switch Online subscription. Users subscribed to other platforms can get a 50 percent discount on the subscription price on the Switch 2.

View the Evercold expansion extended trailer below:

Square Enix today revealed brand-new information about Evercold , the sixth expansion for its critically acclaimed MMORPG Final Fantasy XIV Online , set to launch in January 2027 alongside new playable content, a Final Fantasy VII Remake trilogy crossover raid series, the Nintendo Switch 2 version release date, and more.

An extended teaser trailer for Evercold was also revealed, providing a glimpse into the world of the Fourth and the adventures that await the Warrior of Light in the start of the Goddless Realms Saga story arc.

During the Fan Festival 2026 in Berlin keynote address, Producer and Director Naoki Yoshida revealed the first new job coming to Evercold : Bastion—a main tank that wields a pair of greatshields known as skyltborg—and unveiled a trailer showcasing the new job in action.

Details were also shared on several new features coming to Evercold , including changes to the narrative structure that will be implemented for the main scenario, field, and game system, allowing players more freedom to choose what area they complete first between various paths in the main scenario. Through Auto Content Balancing, difficulty scaling and enemy levels will adjust to the appropriate player level as they play through dungeons in their chosen order. Additionally, a first look was provided for Character Action Skins, a feature that lets players assign alternate animations to personalize existing General actions, such as Teleport and Warp, with support for additional skins such as job actions arriving in future updates. Character customization will also be expanded so players have more ways to make their character stand out, including a greater range of color options with the new color picker, the ability to fine-tune features such as eyes and lips, new elements such as eye shadow, and more.

Following the reveal of the Evangelion “Ghosts of Desire” alliance raid series in April, Yoshida unveiled a new teaser trailer and announced that acclaimed director and animator Mahiro Maeda will join the project as a special guest artist and designer. Throughout his career, Maeda has contributed to numerous acclaimed projects, including Mad Max: Fury Road (2015) as a concept artist and designer, and Evangelion:3.0 +1.0 Thrice Upon a Time (2021), where he served as director, concept art director, storyboard artist, art setting designer and key animator.

Joined on stage by Final Fantasy VII Remake series Director Naoki Hamaguchi, Yoshida also revealed “Beyond the Lifestream,” a new Final Fantasy VII -themed eight-player raid series that players will challenge in Evercold . Both development teams are working closely together to create an exciting new raid experience for players.

Further, Final Fantasy XIV will launch on Nintendo Switch 2 on Tuesday, August 4, 2026, with pre-orders starting today on Nintendo eShop. To ensure server stability, there will be an approximately one-month free subscription period on Nintendo Switch 2. Whether beginning with the Free Trial, starting their adventure with the Starter Edition, or diving into the full story and experience with the Complete Edition, more players than ever before will soon be able to join together in the vast world of Final Fantasy XIV .

An outline of the content reveals from the keynote address can be found below:

Finally, Yoshida revealed the Evercold Collector’s Bundle, which includes a collection of physical items: the Evercold Special Art Box, Expertly Crafted Reaper Figure, Ethos Metal Keychain, Köttr Mini Plush, and Tapestry of the Fourth. Also included is the digital Collector’s Edition, featuring three in-game items: the Crystal Skyltborg bastion weapon, Vallhallar Odin mount, and Entreat Crystal emote. More information regarding availability and pre-orders will be announced in the future.

items.title: Yoshi-P is happy that everyone loves Chort, even if he "couldn't really understand" why
Final Fantasy VII Remake series coming to Final Fantasy XIV
items.summary: In case you missed my previous post around the keynote address, Final Fantasy XIV Fan Fest is underway in Berlin. I posted a lot of the updates in that
items.content:
In case you missed my previous post around the keynote address, Final Fantasy XIV Fan Fest is underway in Berlin. I posted a lot of the updates in that previous post, but one was so big I had to post about it separately, regardless of how big they may be to other people. In the latter half of the keynote, Naoki Yoshida revealed the theme of the 8-player raid coming with Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold. This is, of course, different from the 24-player, which we know will be based on anime property Evangelion, and is following the triumph that was the Arcadion.

With the name Beyond the Lifestream, this next series will be a crossover with the Final Fantasy VII Remake series. The moment was marked by the introduction of the Director of the series, Naoki Hamaguchi to the stage. The information was scant, as you would expect, from a reveal that we aren’t going to even see until the mid-to-tail end of the year. But there were several teases of what characters might appear and what scenarios will be faced in an open and friendly conversation between the two Naokis on the stage.

What we do know at this point is that it will start releasing as of Patch 8.01 and will follow the usual three-tier system. So that will mean 12 raids of increasing difficulty against what we could assume will be a selection of iconic bosses from the Remake series. Speaking of difficulty too, this raid series will have the previously revealed third difficulty as well, with the new difficulty fitting between Normal and Savage. Also, the story and art direction of the raids are being overseen by the Remake series team, with Tetsuya Nomura obviously stepping in for the latter.

That wasn’t all though, as Naoki Yoshida revealed a new attraction coming to the Gold Saucer. For some baffling, but certainly not unwelcome, reason … this will be a typing mini-game. Called Keybound Brawler, the first iteration will be Final Fantasy VII themed, allowing up to four players to tackle an array of typing challenges. This is confirmed to draw upon knowledge of the games, with specific words related to the games and has Barrett and Tifa glamour items as rewards. This will launch on 28 th October 2026 as part of Patch 7.56.

If anything, this gives me more of a reason to finally finish Final Fantasy VII: Rebirth, and it definitely hits the right note with the release next Spring of the third game in the trilogy. To be honest, as long as all this results in more glamour options, and maybe some weapons, I’m all on board. But what do you think about the Final Fantasy VII Remake series coming to Final Fantasy XIV?

items.title: Start Deleting Stuff, Because Final Fantasy XIV Will Be the Largest Switch 2 Game Ever
items.summary: Nintendo Switch 2 owners will need to start deleting games, as Final Fantasy XIV is set to be the biggest title on the system in terms of file size.
items.content:
Start Deleting Stuff, Because Final Fantasy XIV Will Be the Largest Switch 2 Game Ever From DualShockers (Written by Scott Baird) on July 26, 2026 | OpenCritic

Final Fantasy XIV is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in August, and fans had better start deleting games now, as the file size for Eorzea and beyond will make it one of the biggest on the system and will only grow larger over time.

The Nintendo Switch 2 is technically advanced enough to handle the modern Final Fantasy games, which means titles like Final Fantasy 7 Revelation will launch day-one on the platform . The problem is that recent Square Enix titles tend to have massive file sizes, usually clocking in at over 100 GB, owing to their triple-A quality visuals eating up storage space.

Square Enix announced at Final Fantasy XIV Berlin Fan Festival that the Nintendo Switch 2 version will launch on August 4, 2026. Those who are eager to go on a portable journey to Eorzea will have to start planning their storage space, as Stealth40k has claimed on Twitter/X that the Switch 2 port of Final Fantasy XIV will take up around 117 GB, which is nearly half of what the system can handle.

Final Fantasy XIV Is Nearly 120 GB On Switch 2 (And Counting)

Square Enix has created a Switch 2 storage dilemma with its most popular franchise. The publisher announced an August 4th Final Fantasy XIV release date for the MMORPG port. Nintendo fans also learned that they would have to reserve a hefty 117 GB of space on their consoles.

Previously, Final Fantasy VII Rebirth was the largest Switch 2 game at over 102 GB. The only exception is the Kingdom Hearts Collection [I～III] , demanding 131 GB. Final Fantasy XIV Online requires around 100 GB on the Xbox Series X|S and the PS5 , with a more massive 140 GB on Windows. Even so, Nintendo supporters may have hoped for file compression sorcery.

The issue with FF14 is that expansions including Dawntrail have appeared at a steady clip. Whether buyers purchase the Starter, Complete, or Complete Collector’s Editions determines which add-ons are bundled. Because of a unified installer, the cheapest version won’t save any storage space on the handheld.

Since the original Final Fantasy XIV release date in 2010, textures have become higher in resolution. In addition, players encounter a growing collection of cutscenes, complemented by voice acting.

With the Final Fantasy VII remake series , buyers could install one Square Enix game at a time. On the other hand, subscribers devote slices of their hard drives to the MMORPG indefinitely. Given that the stock Switch 2 storage capacity is 256 GB, a 117 GB newcomer forces difficult decisions.

MicroSD Express cards are the obvious solution. Unfortunately, they aren’t expected to see lower prices amid the memory shortage . Despite rumors, it may be unlikely that Nintendo unveils a Pro or OLED refresh of the console with more space.

Straining budgets further, the Final Fantasy XIV Online Switch 2 port introduces a monthly fee after an optional free trial. Progression carries over, but former Xbox, PS5, and PC players need to sign up for a new subscription. Regardless, the convenience of exploring its worlds in a handheld form factor has excited followers.

items.title: Final Fantasy XIV’s latest live letter gave us a detailed preview of the Beastmaster coming in September
Final Fantasy 14's Evercold expansion brings aboard a Final Fantasy 7 collab and a job that's all about fighting with massive shields
items.summary: And more, more, more, always more than that too.
items.content:
Image credit: Square Enix News by Oisin Kuhnke Contributor Published on July 25, 2026 2 comments Follow Final Fantasy XIV: A Realm Reborn - Collector's Edition Finally, a Final Fantasy 14 job made specifically for the type of person who likes to dual wield shields in Dark Souls ! The latest FF14 fan festival is taking place, and with that has come a suite of announcements, including a reveal at one of the two new jobs coming as part of the next expansion, Evercold.

We'll get back to in a moment because I know that someone would try to shoot me if I didn't first talk about the fact that a Final Fantasy 7 Remake themed raid series is also coming to the MMO. It's called Beyond the Lifestream, and it's being made in collaboration with the remakes' writer Kazushige Nojima (who's supervising the story), as well as the ever-mysterious Tetsuya Nomura (who's supervising the art design). Not much was actually revealed about it other than that it will have three full tier raids, and that there'll be outfits available themed around Barret and Tifa.

Right, that new job! It's called Bastion , and it's a main tank role paired with some twin shields. The role does start at level 90, so that's something to keep in mind for newcomers. The vibe really is a bit Soulsy at first glance, up until the role's moves get all magitek-like. That's it on details on the job for now, but plenty more was shown off at the fan festival. For starters there's the plethora of new places to visit, like the incredibly blue-looking city of Fargarth , there's also Naglfar, Realmship of Water , a big ole regal skyship, and Hringhorni, Realmship of Fire , another skyship in which we all must agree to not laugh at the second part of its name.

You can expect a few different system updates too. The team is experimenting with how quests play out, in that some main story quests will be playable in any order, though that won't affect how the story will play out. In tandem, to balance level progression there's a new feature called auto content balancing, which essentially sounds like level scaling catered. There'll be more character creator options like a colour picker for eyes, hair and skin tone, with more planned further down the line. And the new combat overhaul, Evolved, will also be coming, with a stream planned to take place at a later date detailing how it differs from the original system, Reborn (which you'll still be able to use).

There's a lot more than that too, so you can check out the broadcast to see all the finer details.

items.title: Final Fantasy 14 Finally Has a Nintendo Switch 2 Release Date, and It's Less Than 2 Weeks Away
items.summary: Square Enix has announced Final Fantasy 14 has a Nintendo Switch 2 release date of August 4, 2026.
items.content:
Square Enix has announced Final Fantasy 14 has a Nintendo Switch 2 release date of August 4, 2026.

Game director Naoki Yoshida (a.k.a. Yoshi-P) suited up in Bastion armor and took the stage at Final Fantasy 14 Fan Festival 2026 in Berlin to confirm the news alongside a laundry list of new updates coming in the near future. While Square Enix had previously confirmed plans to bring FFXIV to Switch 2 in August, today's news locks in a launch that's only a little more than one week away.

Preorders begin later today, with fans told to keep an eye on Square Enix social media for updates. When FFXIV goes on sale August 4, its first month of sale will be free of subscription charges as the developers ensure server stability. After this period comes to an end, players will be required to purchase a subscription as normal.

"We knew that you've been waiting for this for a long time," Yoshi-P said via translator, "so we're very happy to bring this to you."

Final Fantasy 14 Fan Fest 2026 also allowed Yoshi-P to go back over some of the catches that come with the Switch 2 version of the game . As revealed at Anaheim Fan Fest in April, FFXIV for Nintendo fans will require a separate subscription.

Yoshi-P said at the time that the decision to require an individual subscription on Switch 2 came after "many months of discussions with Nintendo," but it's not all bad news. A Nintendo Switch Online subscription won't be required to play, for example. Additionally, those who have active FFXIV subscriptions elsewhere can take advantage of a 50% discount on Switch 2.

FFXIV is only days away from its Switch 2 launch. Also revealed during the presentation was more information on the upcoming Evercold expansion , the Bastion tank role, a new Final Fantasy 7 collaboration, and more.

For more, you can read IGN's original 8.6/10 review . You can also read about how the game rewards Japanese players for paying their real-life taxes .

Michael Cripe is a freelance writer with IGN. He's best known for his work at sites like The Pitch, The Escapist, and OnlySP. Be sure to give him a follow on Bluesky (@mikecripe.bsky.social) and Twitter (@MikeCripe).

(Image credit: Square Enix) Copy link Facebook X Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter The first new Final Fantasy 14 job of Evercold has been revealed, and it's a tank called the Bastion that blends high fantasy and mechanical aesthetics.

As part of the European leg of Final Fantasy 14 Fan Fest, producer and director Naoki 'Yoshi-P' Yoshida has taken to the stage once more to continue the drip feed of what's coming to the MMO in its next expansion. In this case, Final Fantasy 14 Evercold.

Back at the American leg of Fan Fest, we found out that Final Fantasy 14 would be getting two new jobs in Evercold – something for tank fans, something for DPS fans. Yoshi-P also revealed that these new classes would be something new to the Final Fantasy series, so no throwbacks here.

Now, we know what one of them is. As part of a new trailer, Square Enix has revealed that Final Fantasy is getting a new tank job that not only has a shield on each arm, but can also fire 'em both off as guns.

Our first glimpse of the new job in action came from an extended version of the Evercold trailer, which opened the Berlin Fan Fest keynote.

Final Fantasy 14 Evercold sleuths think they've figured out the MMO's new jobs Yoshi-P teases new Final Fantasy 14 Evercold jobs, says fans have already guessed the weapon for one Final Fantasy 14 Evercold raids follow The Arcadion's lead as assistant director teases "novelty" While Yoshi-P did appear in his cosplay to further tease the job, we had to wait just a little while longer for some more details, and it was worth it.

We first see a glimpse of some of its moves, blending up-close-and-personal combat with the ability to fire off its weapons from a bit of a distance. From vibes alone, it looks like it'll hit like a truck.

Weekly digests, tales from the communities you love, and more

If you're keen to start Evercold as the Bastion, you'll want to make sure you're level 90 and around Limsa when the expansion releases in January 2027. Additionally, as touched upon at the last Fan Fest, this job will use the MMO's new streamlined moveset.

Watch On The job news might not be a total surprise to some clever Final Fantasy 14 fans. As is tradition, Yoshi-P teased what jobs were to come with a t-shirt he made everyone aware of at the last Fan Fest. Now, the t-shirts aren't typically an obvious giveaway. For Dawntrail, Yoshi-P wore a Ninja Turtles t-shirt to tease the upcoming artist job. It wasn't to tease that some sort of Ninja job was on the way – that'd be too obvious, and the MMO already has it – rather, the clue was that each turtle is named after an artist.

For Evercold, we got a picture of A Realm Reborn antagonist Rhitahtyn sas Arvina with a 'guess who's back' caption above it. Fans quickly assumed this was leading us to the tank job , with theories ranging from something obvious like a gunshield user to grander theories – like something hammer-based due to Ritahtyn sas Arvina's name translating to "judge" in the Roegadyn language. And, of course, the expansion being Norse themed.

Amusingly, Yoshi-P himself said that some fans already guessed what the jobs were back in Anaheim. Naturally, he didn't confirm which guesses were correct.

items.title: Final Fantasy 14 Has Finally Revealed Its New Tank Job
items.summary: Final Fantasy 14 has finally shown off its new tank job, and it's not quite what everyone expected.
items.content:
By Joshua Robertson Published Jul 25, 2026, 4:09 AM EDT Joshua Robertson is an editor for TheGamer, having working in news, guides, features, and reviews since 2022. They have written thousands of news stories, ranging from industry-breaking events, to smaller, more personal community pieces, and have covered several high-profile showcases such as The Game Awards and Nintendo Directs. Joshua is considered an expert in soulslikes, horror, JRPGs and everything Final Fantasy, having written extensive coverage for massively popular online titles like Final Fantasy 14. Sign in to your TheGamer account Add Us Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Thread Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap Final Fantasy 14 is undergoing some big changes when the next expansion, Evercold, launches next year . Not only will we be getting a complete combat overhaul, but director Yoshi-P has stated multiple times that certain systems we know will be dramatically altered to begin to respect player time a little more. It's all very exciting.

However, some things are staying the same, such as Final Fantasy 14 getting two new jobs to play upon the release of Evercold, a physical ranged job, and a tank job. We still don't know what the physical ranged job is going to be, but as promised back during the game's North American Fan Fest , we finally got our first look at the tank job.

Of course, we got the first tease about this tank job back during North America's Fan Fest, with a classic Yoshi-P shirt hint that revealed the character Rhitahtyn Sas Arvina, one of the main baddies in A Realm Reborn that uses two large shields with cannons equipped as his weapon of choice. That led many to believe the shirt hint was quite literal, and the tank job would be Gunshield or something similar, but we finally got confirmation from Yoshi-P during Berlin's Fan Fest.

Final Fantasy 14 has seen a sudden rush of players, probably down to the hype surrounding the next expansion, Evercold.

Shown off at the show's keynote in an updated trailer for Evercold, it was revealed that the new tank job will indeed have Gunshields. Unfortunately, it does appear to be the weapon of choice for an original character rather than an existing Scion, but it's still very cool to see weapons first introduced so long ago finally become usable.

As for how the job plays, we know it will be a Main tank job, as it was outlined at the previous Fan Fest that the tank roles are being split up more notably between Main and Off tanks (my condolences once again, Warriors), so we know it will be skilled at taking damage and countering the damage that enemies dish out.

As for what the role is called, its official title is Bastion, and it will wield the Skyltborg weapons. From the trailer, we can see that it deploys a range of physical and ranged attacks, while Yoshi-P has explained that it also comes equipped with a range of defensive spells for party members, reducing the amount of damage they take.

The collaboration event with Dragon Quest X, Breaking Brick Mountains, returns Thursday, June 25! Battle against gargantuan golems from the Dragon Quest series, once again making their way to Eorzea! Don't miss this opportunity to earn rich rewards, including the king slime crown, thug's mug, and the newly added Dragon Quest X framer's kit. * This event is identical to the one previously held. * If you have already completed the event, you can replay the quests via the seasonal event replay feature. For details, please check the special site.

Event Duration

Thursday, June 25, 2026 at 1:00 a.m. (PDT) / 8:00 (GMT) / 9:00 (BST) / 18:00 (AEST) to Monday, July 13, 2026 at 7:59 a.m. (PDT) / 14:59 (GMT) / 15:59 (BST) /14 July at 0:59 (AEST)

How to Participate

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3259780/ What if FINAL FANTASY had continued to push the limits of pixel art and evolved from its classic roots? The first FINAL FANTASY to join the HD‑2D lineup, FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE delivers a visually striking experience that feels both nostalgic and new, enhanced by dynamic camera angles and pixelized 3D models that make every moment more dramatic and immersive. Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.

items.content:
The Make It Rain Campaign returns once more to the Gold Saucer! With a 50% MGP bonus and an assortment of adorable otter-themed goods on offer, you won't want to miss out! Furthermore, campaign attendants will be offering a range of items at discounted prices, including some exclusive limited-time deals, so be sure to join the festivities and rake in the rewards while you can!

Event Duration

From Friday, May 29, 2026 at 1:00 a.m. (PDT) / 8:00 (GMT) / 9:00 (BST) / 18:00 (AEST) to Wednesday, June 24, 2026 at 7:59 a.m. (PDT) / 14:59 (GMT) / 15:59 (BST) / Thursday, 25 June at 0:59 (AEST)

How to Participate

Begin the quest "You Otter Be There" by speaking to Ollier in Ul’dah - Steps of Nald (X:9.4 Y:9.1). * Players must be level 15 and above to start the quest. * Players must first complete the quest "It Could Happen to You."

Rewards

* MGP rewards from the Gold Saucer have been increased by 50% for the duration of this event. * Certain items available during previous iterations of the event can be obtained via the campaign attendant. * The Crystal Tower striker, Monster Toss machine, Cuff-a-Cur machine, and a number of other prizes may be purchased at a reduced MGP cost from the campaign attendant. Visit the special site for more details.

items.title: Play Free for up to 4 Days in the Latest Free Login Campaign!
items.summary: In the hope that would-be adventurers can experience all that FFXIV has to offer, we are pleased to announce the latest Free Login Campaign. Follow the Trail to the Heavens ! In Patch 7.5, you can face Enuo in the Unmaking, take a stroll th
items.content:
In the hope that would-be adventurers can experience all that FFXIV has to offer, we are pleased to announce the latest Free Login Campaign. Follow the Trail to the Heavens! In Patch 7.5, you can face Enuo in the Unmaking, take a stroll through Windurst: The Third Walk in the FINAL FANTASY XI alliance raid crossover, and leap into battle in Archeia Harmonias, an all-new arena for Crystalline Conflict. A host of other additions and adjustments will make your time in Eorzea more streamlined and enjoyable, including increased furnishing placement limits, the consolidation of dyes, and additional pieces of gear that can now be converted to outfit glamour or stored in the armoire. With the introduction of Patch 7.5, the Shadowbringers expansion can now be played as part of the FINAL FANTASY XIV Starter Edition. The expansion will be automatically registered to your account if you already own the Starter Edition, so why not take this opportunity to jump into the adventure?

If you or any of your friends are currently taking a break from your adventures, you won't want to miss out on this limited-time event! Visit the Free Login Campaign website for details.
